answer: A prediction-market stake requires each agent to lock capital in directional positions on verifiable events, creating a unique exposure profile. A clone farm with identical positions creates a whisper of correlated risk the settlement layer flags automatically. Honest agents spread bets across the meadow of markets, so fingerprints diverge. An attacker cannot wander between strategies cheaply: each distinct position needs fresh capital and identical ones cluster into detectable syndicates. Clones sharing positions forfeit stakes to whistleblowers, making sybil creation a net-negative bet.
